test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

As there was no one to __look thorough__ the orphan, he had to take refuge in the orphanage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase 'look thorough' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase that fits the context is **'look after'**, which means to take care of someone.
 
• **Look after** is a** phrasal verb commonly used to denote taking care of someone or something**.
 
 
• Example: She** looks after** her younger brother when her parents are at work.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase is 'look after'.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***As there was no one to look after__ the orphan, he had to take refuge in the orphanage*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**The other options do not fit the context:

 
• **look through:** to examine or read something quickly.
 
• **look upon:** to regard or consider.
 
• **look down upon:** to regard with contempt.
 
• Using **the correct phrasal verb** is** essential **for conveying the intended meaning **accurately.**
